test_cases.title: Pending customer updates list shows QAL Number, Customer Name and Details
acs: DERIVED: Review Pending Customer Updates lists QAL Number, Customer Name and Details with at least one row - route /Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx (crawl, docs/discovery/coverage-plan.md)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
Read-only: nothing is changed. The seed data holds two rows (QAL/0344, QAL/03086); only at least one row is asserted.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The page loads and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Customer Updates.

steps.action: Look at the first column heading of the table.
steps.expected: The column heading QAL Number is shown.

steps.action: Look at the second and third column headings of the table.
steps.expected: The column headings Customer Name and Details are shown.

steps.action: Count the data rows in the table.
steps.expected: At least one data row is shown, with a QAL Number, a Customer Name and a Details link.

test_cases.title: Pending customer update details show Approve, Decline and Cancel and Cancel changes nothing
acs: DERIVED: Details opens PendingCustomerUpdateDetails.aspx?CustomerId=<guid> with the buttons Approve, Decline and Cancel; Cancel returns to the list - route /Contracts Admin/PendingCustomerUpdateDetails.aspx (crawl; Cancel destination TODO)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
Approve and Decline are checked for presence only and are not selected, because they consume seed data.
Nothing is changed, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Customer Updates and at least one row is shown.

steps.action: Note the QAL Number and Customer Name of the first row as <first QAL number> and <first customer name>.
steps.expected: The two values are recorded.

steps.action: Select the Details link on the first row.
steps.expected: The page PendingCustomerUpdateDetails.aspx opens and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Look at the buttons on the page without selecting Approve or Decline.
steps.expected: The buttons Approve, Decline and Cancel are visible.

steps.action: Select Cancel.
steps.expected: The page returns to the Review Pending Customer Updates list.

steps.action: Look for the row with <first QAL number> and <first customer name>.
steps.expected: The row is still listed, so nothing was approved or declined.

test_cases.title: Pending participant updates page opens with its heading
acs: DERIVED: Review Pending Participant Updates opens with its h1 and shows There are no pending participants to display. only when none exist - route /Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingParticipantUpdates.aspx (crawl, docs/discovery/coverage-plan.md)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
Read-only: the number of pending participants is not asserted because it depends on the data.
The message There are no pending participants to display. is checked only when the list is empty.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Customer Updates.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingParticipantUpdates.aspx.
steps.expected: The page loads and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Participant Updates.

steps.action: Look at the content under the heading.
steps.expected: Either a table of pending participants or the message There are no pending participants to display. is shown.

steps.action: If no pending participants are listed, read the message.
steps.expected: The message reads There are no pending participants to display.

test_cases.title: Admin approves and declines pending customer updates
acs: DERIVED: Approve and Decline on PendingCustomerUpdateDetails.aspx resolve the pending customer update - route /Contracts Admin/PendingCustomerUpdateDetails.aspx (buttons seen in the crawl; outcome TODO)
assumptions: NOT repeatable: each Approve or Decline consumes a seeded pending update (two rows exist). Automate as @wip.
The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
The outcome messages and list behaviour after Approve and Decline are not recorded (see open_questions).
Cleanup is not possible from the UI; the seed data needs a reset.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Customer Updates and at least two rows are shown.

steps.action: Note the QAL Number of the first row as <approve QAL number> and of the second row as <decline QAL number>.
steps.expected: The two QAL Numbers are recorded.

steps.action: Select Details on the row for <approve QAL number>, then select Approve.
steps.expected: <outcome message after Approve> is shown and the page leaves the details view.

steps.action: Check the Review Pending Customer Updates list.
steps.expected: The row for <approve QAL number> is no longer listed.

steps.action: Select Details on the row for <decline QAL number>, then select Decline.
steps.expected: <outcome message after Decline> is shown and the page leaves the details view.

steps.action: Check the Review Pending Customer Updates list.
steps.expected: The row for <decline QAL number> is no longer listed.

steps.action: Cleanup: ask the environment owner to reset the seed data.
steps.expected: Both pending customer updates are listed again after the reset.
